description.html: The crocodile skull replica shows a long, flat snout with a row of pointed teeth, eye openings on top of the head and a nostril at the very tip of the snout. The surface is ivory-colored with a fine, rough bone texture, so the skull looks realistic even up close.

In an aquarium it is an excellent choice for themed river or swamp setups, where fish swim around it and shelter in the openings and underneath. In a terrarium it fits nicely into aqua-terrariums and desert setups, and small animals use it as a shelter. Thanks to its low, elongated shape, it looks good in the foreground, where all the details are visible.

Before placing the skull, rinse it with lukewarm water, without soap. Set it on a flat bottom and check that it stands steadily and does not rock on its teeth. If you keep larger animals, make sure the openings are not a size in which an animal could get stuck. Algae and dirt between the teeth are easiest to remove with a soft brush; for a complete setup, see our other equipment.
